title: Precheck runs each planted check the way land does, in a scratch worktree on a work branch with an empty cache
goal: bl_precheck runs each committed item's checks and repro in a scratch worktree on a work/<id> branch with an empty _cache and an isolated CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA, as land does, so a check that depends on the cwd's branch or a warm cache fails at planning, not at the land step checks (SP-uh5h46fm: ST-drlo365l's and BG-2n4csy5p's checks were refused at land); kb/_self/backlog.md and the sprint skill say so.

run:
import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_precheck
from pathlib import Path
code='import subprocess,sys;sys.exit(1 if subprocess.check_output([\'git\',\'rev-parse\',\'--abbrev-ref\',\'HEAD\'],text=True).startswith(\'work/\') else 0)'
item={'status':'todo','checks':[{'run':['python3','-c',code]}]}
bl=type('B',(),{'root':Path.cwd(),'items':{'ST-aaaaaaaa':item},'sprint_items':lambda self,sid:['ST-aaaaaaaa']})()
rows=bl_precheck.precheck_rows(bl,'SP-aaaaaaaa')
sys.exit(0 if len(rows)==1 and rows[0][3] is False else 1)
